name: my-toolkit
description: Personal Claude Code plugins: one always-on core plus small opt-in kits.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Always-on: planner, code/security reviewers, TDD and build agents, core skills, common rules loaded at session start.

plugins.name: typescript-react
plugins.description: Opt-in kit for TypeScript, React and Next.js: reviewers, React build resolver, React/testing/frontend skills, and a standards skill.

plugins.name: project-starter
plugins.description: Opt-in: new-project skill that bootstraps a repo (interview, scaffold, project layer, verification, push to an empty repo you created). Install only in your bootstrap environment.
